segment.description: Richardson 'Byrd' Creek, Hancock County — the small TWRA hatchery-supported trout creek that runs down to the upper Clinch River above the Norris pool (catalog). Identity verified by county: TWRA's 2026 stocking schedule carries 'Richardson 'Byrd' Creek' only under Hancock County (Region 4); other Byrd Creek namesakes elsewhere are not in the schedule. Catalog hydroIdentity: HUC 06010205 (Upper Clinch), GNIS 01269411/01299343/01299344.
segment.boundaries: Whole creek in Hancock County as stocked by TWRA; no formal agency reach boundaries documented. Catalog notes a narrow, wooded, rain-flashy channel dropping to the Clinch headwater reach above the Norris pool.

coldSource.notes: No cold-water source documented. No dam upstream, no spring influence on record. The stocking program type is itself the TWRA signal: the creek carries Seasonal-type (spring, Feb-Apr 2026 weeks) rainbow rows only, and the TWRA Trout Management Plan 2017-2027 places hatchery-supported streams in the class that 'are primarily warmwater habitats that cannot support trout year round'.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found in any checked source. Program design is spring put-and-take: all four TWRA 2026 rows for the creek (weeks of 2/8, 3/1, 3/22 and 4/12/2026) are Seasonal-type Rainbow Trout stockings with no winter program entries.

wildPopulation.detail: Not on TWRA's Wild Trout Streams list (trout regulations page checked 2026-09-18 — no Byrd/Richardson entry) and the Trout Management Plan contains no wild trout record for the creek.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: Spring-only put-and-take rainbow water: TWRA's 2026 schedule stocks Richardson 'Byrd' Creek (Hancock Co.) solely as four Seasonal Feb-Apr rainbow events, and the Trout Management Plan classifies hatchery-supported streams like this as 'primarily warmwater habitats that cannot support trout year round'.
